patch_list: Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.
Unlocks unlimited journals and widgets, premium templates, brushes, papers, stamp options, HD video export without a watermark, more pictures per page, longer PDF imports and sync for every journal.
